name: CommonsCollections1
description: Apache Commons Collections 3.x — uses InvokerTransformer chain via LazyMap. Works on Java ≤8u76.
detection_hint: Java serialized object; look for commons-collections on classpath.

name: CommonsCollections2
description: Apache Commons Collections 4.x — uses PriorityQueue + InvokerTransformer.
detection_hint: Look for CC4 on classpath or any modern spring application.

name: CommonsCollections3
description: Alternative to CC1; uses TemplatesImpl to bypass denylist filters.
detection_hint: Useful when CC1/CC6 are blocked by filters checking class name.

name: CommonsCollections4
description: CC4 with TemplatesImpl — avoids class name-based filters on CC2.

name: CommonsCollections5
description: CC3 chain via BadAttributeValueExpException — works on JDK ≥8u76.

name: CommonsCollections6
description: Version-agnostic CC chain — works on all JDK versions without restrictions.

name: CommonsCollections7
description: Hashtable-based CC3 — avoids HashMap in deserialization blocklists.

name: Spring1
description: Spring Framework Spring1 gadget chain using MethodInvokingFactoryBean.

name: Spring2
description: Spring Framework alternative chain using ObjectFactoryDelegatingInvocationHandler.

name: Groovy1
description: Apache Groovy deserialization via MethodClosure — works on Groovy 1.7.0-2.4.3.

name: JBoss
description: JBoss Application Server deserialization gadget chain.

name: Jdk7u21
description: Pure JDK gadget (≤7u21) — TemplatesImpl + LinkedHashSet bypass. No third-party libs needed.

name: Hibernate1
description: Hibernate ORM deserialization using TypedValue comparison.

name: Hibernate2
description: Hibernate alternative via BasicPropertyAccessor.

name: IIOP
description: Java IIOP/CORBA deserialization chain — targets RMI registry.

name: URLClassLoader
description: Remote class loading via URL class loader — pulls bytecode from attacker server.

name: URLDNS
description: Pure JDK DNS lookup for blind deserialization detection — no RCE, just SSRF/DNS callback.

name: FileRead1
description: Java deserialization for arbitrary file read via XMLDecoder.

name: RichFaces3
description: RichFaces 3.x ViewState deserialization — Expression Language injection path.

name: Mojarra
description: JSF Mojarra ViewState deserialization (CVE-2013-5855 family).
